name: Product Rescue
summary: A bounded assessment or sprint for a live product blocked by instability, delivery risk, or a difficult handover.
workingRhythm: 3–5 business-day assessment or a 10-business-day rescue sprint

name: Agency Partner
summary: White-label, overflow, or embedded engineering support that protects the agency's client relationship.
workingRhythm: Defined projects or reserved monthly capacity

name: Full Product Build
summary: End-to-end engineering for a new web, mobile, backend, or Web3 product with a clear product owner.
workingRhythm: Milestone-based discovery, build, verification, and handover

name: Maintenance & Stabilization
summary: Planned product care after launch, covering agreed fixes, upgrades, monitoring, and delivery support.
workingRhythm: Monthly retained capacity with an agreed queue and response model
